source.title: Bakers & Baristas Nutrition & Allergen Guide, United Kingdom, Autumn 2026 (Version #20, updated 1 September 2026; PDF created 21 August 2026)

note: Bakers & Baristas prints calories only, per item as sold (drinks per size and milk), so protein, carbs and fat are not published. Halal products sold in selected stores, ice cream (per 100 g) and items without calories are not listed. The chain says it handles all allergens in its kitchens and cannot guarantee any item is allergen free.
